added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite receipts: baseline_suite reports completed true with 58 passed, EXIT=0 and failure_ids []; after_suite reports completed true with 60 passed, EXIT=0 and failure_ids []; the head-minus-base set is empty. Separately, the partition-job requirement for those arms is a blocking evidence finding.

assertion_analysis.175: the exit-code assertion fails if cleanup is known to be unfinished past an ended attempt.
assertion_analysis.176: the pointer-absence assertion fails if cleanup keeps the pointer, which negative-control.log shows is the base behaviour.
assertion_analysis.177-179: the receipt assertion fails if cleanup deletes attempt-N-exit.json along with the pointer.
assertion_analysis.202-203: the live-launch case fails if the pointer is removed or the refusal omits the message, the attempt number or the launcher pid.
assertion_analysis.204-205: the launcher pid in the message must be the reservation's launcher_pid, which differs from the supervisor_pid the fixture supplies, so naming the supervisor reddens it.
assertion_analysis.206: the pointer-presence assertion fails if a live launch's pointer is taken.
assertion_analysis.51: promotion's pointer_path is resolved against the fixture's tmp_path, so the assertion fails if the pointer path stops honouring RECKON_HOME; it replaces the deleted REAL_LIVE machine-state fixture.

assertion_independence: No same-variable assertion found in the delta: :51 compares production's own pointer_path answer to the fixture's tmp_path, and :205 compares the command's output to a launcher pid distinct from the supervisor pid the fixture also writes, so a regression that names the supervisor reddens it.

0.reason: superseded by coordinator arms: the landing evidence is six all_debug jobs 1320481-1320486 at main c3619ffc75 and merged 2495853e51, logs under ~/.cache/reckon-landing/s71-final/ each opening with revision and literal command and ending EXIT=; 70 base failures, 68 merged, 0 added. The fragment's arm paragraph is not relied on.

findings.text: blocking: the arm paragraph asserts each arm's log opens with revision, tree, literal command, module path and cwd, but the all_debug job's per-arm logs were overwritten by a fleet-node foreground rerun and sbatch-arms.log carries only two summary lines.
blocking: baseline_suite and after_suite cite the fleet-node foreground rerun logs, not the all_debug job the done_when requires and never on the fleet node.
non-blocking: the gate sentence cites 2 passed in 2.87s at 06c3e5b20a, a run no log on disk records; gate-head.log records 2 passed in 3.81s at 347c919ecf.
non-blocking: the _reservation_launcher fallback to the reservation's own pid changes naming for pre-split reservations and no test covers a reservation without launcher_pid.

item_verdicts.diff: 06c3e5b20a is the code and test repair, 3f202a80c1 and 347c919ecf edit only the evidence fragment's arm paragraph.
item_verdicts.done_when: s71's measure wants two integration cases, a base negative control and partition-run matched arms with per-arm logs; the cases and control are proven, the arm logs are not.
item_verdicts.goal: dispatch-detail.json admit_request.node.goal requires finishing cleanup past a changed pointer or naming the launch; promotion.py:593 and :609 implement both and the delta preserves them.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md records the three commits, the literal gate command, both suites and the negative controls, with the arm receipt defect noted in the findings.
item_verdicts.write_paths: declared paths are the two Python files and the evidence fragment; the delta diff touches no other file.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows both cases redden at base with the removed refusal, and tests/test_a_promotion_finishes_past_a_station_resume.py:205 names a launcher pid distinct from the supervisor, but nothing covers the legacy-reservation fallback promotion.py:344 introduces.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log:1-7 and negative-control.log are complete, but manifest.md:23-24 receipts come from fleet-node foreground reruns.
justifications.fit: promotion.py:317 and :342 use the repository's lazy cross-module import idiom (watch_unit.py:320, dispatching/fences.py:52).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:593 finishes cleanup past an ended attempt and :609/:619 name the attempt and its launcher.
justifications.reuse: promotion.py:319 and :344 now delegate to dispatch_launch._read_reservation and _reservation_launcher, whose owners exist and were extended rather than duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in 4136dbae..347c919ecf is one of the three declared paths.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: read the node goal in dispatch-detail.json admit_request.node.goal ("Finish a promotion's cleanup past a pointer changed by a launch since it began, or name that launch"); reckon/crew/promotion.py:544-620 implements both arms - it retires a pointer whose newer attempt recorded its end at :593 and refuses naming the launch at :609 and :619.
VERDICT done_when: done_when wants two integration cases on a temporary repository and crew home, a base-revision negative control that refuses with "changed while promotion ran", and matched importer arms run as an all_debug sbatch job whose per-arm logs open with revision and literal command; gate-head.log and negative-control.log prove the cases and the control, but the per-arm logs the done_when describes no longer exist on disk.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_promotion_finishes_past_a_station_resume.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/a-promotion-finishes-past-a-station-resume.html; every path in the delta diff 4136dbae..347c919ecf is inside that set.
VERDICT manifest: read manifest.md; it records commits 06c3e5b20a, 3f202a80c1 and 347c919ecf, the literal gate command with 2 passed in 3.81s EXIT=0, base negative control 2 failed EXIT=1, and baseline/after suites of 58 and 60 passed with no failing ids.
VERDICT diff: read the three commits against 4136dbae - 06c3e5b20a routes the reservation read through dispatch_launch._read_reservation and the launcher through _reservation_launcher and drops the test's REAL_LIVE machine-state fixture for an in-temp-home pointer assertion, while 3f202a80c1 and 347c919ecf only edit the evidence fragment's arm paragraph.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/promotion.py:1846 _complete_locked (calls _remove_promoted_pointer_or_defer at :2006 and :2697), reckon/crew/promotion.py:544 _remove_promoted_pointer_or_defer (refusals at :609 and :619 format through _launching_process_named)

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:593 finishes cleanup past an ended attempt and :609/:619 name the attempt and its launcher, and the delta's reuse wrap leaves both behaviours intact.
SCORE evidence: 12
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head.log:1-7 records 2 passed EXIT=0 at 347c919ecf and negative-control.log ends 2 failed EXIT=1 with "changed while promotion ran", but the arm receipts at manifest.md:23-24 are fleet-node foreground reruns rather than the all_debug job the done_when requires.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the delta touches only reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_promotion_finishes_past_a_station_resume.py and the declared evidence fragment.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: negative-control.log shows both cases redden at base with the removed refusal, and the test's "pid <launcher>" assertion at tests/test_a_promotion_finishes_past_a_station_resume.py:205 names a pid distinct from the supervisor, but nothing covers the legacy-reservation fallback promotion.py:344 introduces.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: promotion.py:317 and :342 import dispatch_launch's own readers lazily inside the function, the idiom used at reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:320 and reckon/crew/dispatching/fences.py:52.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: _attempt_reservation now delegates its parse to dispatch_launch._read_reservation (promotion.py:319) and _launching_process_named to _reservation_launcher (:344), and no owner validating a reservation's run id exists (held_launch_reservation dispatch_launch.py:2790 does not).
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/a-promotion-finishes-past-a-station-resume.html:90 blocking: the arm paragraph asserts each arm's log opens with its revision, tree, literal command, imported module path and resolved cwd and ends with EXIT=, but no such log from the all_debug job survives - suite-base.log and suite-head.log were overwritten at 20:59-21:00Z by a fleet-node foreground rerun (suite-head.log:1-2 now name revision 347c919ecf and the fleet worktree) and sbatch-arms.log carries only host, job, partition and two summary lines, so the document asserts a property of files a reader cannot find.
FINDING /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261116T034015654210-a-promotion-finishes-past-a-station-resume/manifest.md:23 blocking: baseline_suite and after_suite cite suite-base.log and suite-head.log, which are the foreground reruns on the fleet node (trees under /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch and the fleet worktree), while the done_when requires the matched arms run as an all_debug sbatch job and never on the fleet node and the job's own per-arm logs were overwritten, so the receipt pair promotion reads attests the wrong node.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/a-promotion-finishes-past-a-station-resume.html:80 non-blocking: the gate sentence cites 2 passed in 2.87s at 06c3e5b20a, but no log on disk records that run and the manifest's gate log records 2 passed in 3.81s at 347c919ecf (gate-head.log:1,7), so the figure cannot be reconciled with any retained artefact.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion.py:344 non-blocking: routing the launcher read through _reservation_launcher adds a fallback to the reservation's own pid for a record written before the launcher/supervisor split, changing what a refusal names for such a reservation, and no test exercises a reservation without launcher_pid - negative-control-reuse.log records that reverting the whole reuse commit leaves both cases green.

definitions._attempt_reservation: Now wraps dispatch_launch._read_reservation and adds only a run-id check; no owner validating a reservation's run id exists (dispatch_launch.py:2790 held_launch_reservation does not).
definitions._launching_process_named: Wraps dispatch_launch._reservation_launcher; promotion-specific refusal formatter with no existing owner.
definitions.test the_real_pointer_directory_is_not_a: The machine-state guard is replaced by an in-temp-home pointer resolution assertion.

reuse_audit.searched: reckon/crew for reservation parsers (dispatch_launch._read_reservation, reservations_in, held_launch_reservation) and launcher readers (_reservation_launcher, _reservation_names_this_process).
